chat.composer.attachDisabled.zh: 请先选择项目或文件夹
chat.composer.attachDisabled.en: Pick a project or folder first

chat.composer.attachHint.zh: 添加附件 — 任意格式。保存到项目中，Coder 可直接读取。
chat.composer.attachHint.en: Attach files — any format. Saved to the project and readable by the Coder.

chat.composer.disabledPlaceholder.zh: 请先选择项目或文件夹，再开始对话
chat.composer.disabledPlaceholder.en: Pick a project or folder to start chatting

chat.composer.footerHint.zh: Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行 · 📎 拖拽 / 粘贴 / 点回形针上传任意格式文件
chat.composer.footerHint.en: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline · 📎 drag, paste, or click the paperclip to attach any file

chat.composer.fullAccessConfirm.zh: 开启全权访问？agent 将能读写任意路径（含工作目录之外）。
chat.composer.fullAccessConfirm.en: Turn on full access? The agent will then be able to read and write any path, including outside the working directory.

chat.composer.fullAccessReadFailed.zh: 读取全权访问状态失败，请检查后端连接。
chat.composer.fullAccessReadFailed.en: Could not read the full-access state — check the backend connection.

chat.composer.fullAccessTip.zh: 关闭工具沙箱：允许 agent 读写工作目录之外的路径。全局生效。
chat.composer.fullAccessTip.en: Disables the tool sandbox: lets the agent read and write paths outside the working directory. Applies globally.

chat.composer.fullAccessWriteFailed.zh: 保存全权访问设置失败，已恢复原状态。
chat.composer.fullAccessWriteFailed.en: Could not save the full-access setting — reverted to the previous state.

chat.composer.intentChatTip.zh: 自动识别为聊天 — 单轮回复

chat.composer.intentTaskTip.zh: 自动识别为任务 — Coder ↔ Reviewer 完整循环
chat.composer.intentTaskTip.en: Auto-classified as task — full Coder ↔ Reviewer loop

chat.composer.needProject.zh: 先选一个项目或文件夹，再上传附件。
chat.composer.needProject.en: Pick a project or folder before uploading attachments.

chat.composer.placeholder.zh: 输入消息 — 智能体将自动判断走聊天（单轮回复）还是任务（完整循环）。
chat.composer.placeholder.en: Type a message — the agent will route to chat (single reply) or task (full loop) automatically.

chat.composer.sendAsTask.zh: 以任务发送（Coder ↔ Reviewer 完整循环）
chat.composer.sendAsTask.en: Send as task (full Coder ↔ Reviewer loop)

chat.composer.uploadFailed.en: Attachment upload failed — please try again.

chat.thread.expandResult.zh: 点击展开返回结果（{n} 字符）

chat.thread.empty.zh: 发送一条消息，开始循环。
chat.thread.empty.en: Send a message to start the loop.

chat.subagent.pollHint.zh: 子代理结束后，用 subagent_status / subagent_result 取回结果。
chat.subagent.pollHint.en: When it finishes, use subagent_status / subagent_result to collect the result.

chat.thread.tokenUsage.zh: 这条回复消耗的 token 数

chat.artifacts.previewFailed.zh: 预览加载失败，请下载后查看。
chat.artifacts.previewFailed.en: Could not load the preview — download the file instead.
